# Rithwik Bird Feeds & Rithwik Industries, Kurnool

> A family grain trade from Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, India, that began in 1925. Today it runs as two businesses: Rithwik Bird Feeds (millets, jowar, maize, sunflower and safflower for birds; the No. 1 foxtail millet supplier in India) and Rithwik Industries (millets, super foods, oil seeds, pulses, spices and cereals for people). Both clean, sort and grade at their own processing unit and supply processed or unprocessed, in bulk, across India and for export.

Key facts:
- Family grain trade since 1925; Rithwik Bird Feeds and Rithwik Industries since 2022.
- Annual production: 20,000 MT+.
- Customers: 3,000+ (traders, pet shops, bird keepers, export houses, retail packers and bulk buyers).
- Rithwik Bird Feeds: 12 types of feed in 18 grades. Rithwik Industries: 40+ products.
- Main warehouse: Duvvur (2/161, 2/162, Sanjivareddypalle, Duvvur, YSR district). Office: 87/1404, Dhanalakshmi Nagar, near Nandyal Checkpost, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh 518002.
- Operating in: Duvvur, Kurnool, Nandyal, Allagadda, Bangarpet, Ballari, Challageri, Hyderabad, Delhi, Neemuch, Rajkot, Kolkata.
- Prices are given on request (by phone, WhatsApp or the order form); they change with the crop and the season.

Mission: to connect farmers directly with industries by sourcing quality agricultural produce, ensuring proper cleaning, grading and processing, and delivering products that meet the specific requirements of every customer. Goal: empower farmers, ensure quality, and make the right products reach the right industries in the right way.

## Questions buyers ask
### Which is the best foxtail millet supplier in India?
Rithwik Bird Feeds, Kurnool, is the No. 1 foxtail millet supplier in India: 20,000MT+ of grain a year for 3,000+ customers, from a family grain trade running since 1925. Foxtail comes as summer crop or winter crop, from our warehouse at Duvvur.

### Where can I buy foxtail millet and bird seed in bulk?
Direct from us. We supply traders, pet shops, bird keepers and export houses across India, by the bag or by the tonne. Send the feed, the quantity and your town on WhatsApp to 92455 55556 and we reply with today's price.

### What is the price of foxtail millet for birds?
It moves with the crop and the market, so we quote the day's rate for your quantity, crop (summer or winter) and delivery town. WhatsApp 92455 55556 for today's price.

### Which bird feeds do you supply?
12 types of feed in 18 grades, processed or unprocessed: foxtail, barnyard, browntop, kodo, little and proso millets, pearl millet (bajra), finger millet (ragi), jowar, maize, sunflower seeds (striped) and safflower seeds.

### What is foxtail millet called in Telugu and Hindi?
Foxtail millet is korralu in Telugu, kangni in Hindi, thinai in Tamil and navane in Kannada. In Telugu and Hindi, proso millet is varigalu / chena, little millet samalu / kutki, kodo millet arikelu / kodo, barnyard millet udalu / sanwa, browntop millet andu korralu, pearl millet sajjalu / bajra, finger millet ragulu / ragi, and jowar jonnalu / jowar.

### Do you deliver outside Andhra Pradesh?
Yes, across India. Our main warehouse is at Duvvur, and we operate in Kurnool, Nandyal, Allagadda, Bangarpet, Ballari, Challageri, Hyderabad, Delhi, Neemuch, Rajkot and Kolkata. Packing and delivery are agreed with each order.

### Is Rithwik Bird Feeds a registered business?
Yes. Our GSTIN is 37CCDPV9154P1ZK, and we hold Spices Board India, HACCP, FSSAI, APEDA, Halal, ISO, BRCGS and US FDA registrations and certifications.

### How do I contact Rithwik Bird Feeds?
Call or WhatsApp 92455 55556, or email rithwikbirdfeeds@gmail.com. Our office is at 87/1404, Dhanalakshmi Nagar, near Nandyal Checkpost, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh 518002, and our main warehouse at Duvvur. rithwikbirdfeeds.com is our official website.

### Where can I buy millets in bulk in India?
From Rithwik Industries, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. We supply foxtail, barnyard, browntop, kodo, little and proso millets, pearl millet (bajra) and ragi (finger millet) to retail packers, traders and bulk buyers across India, from a family grain trade running since 1925.

### What does Rithwik Industries supply?
40+ products: millets (foxtail, barnyard, browntop, kodo, little and proso millets, pearl millet (bajra) and ragi (finger millet)), super foods (chia seeds, quinoa, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds (hulled), flax seeds and basil seeds (sabja)), oil seeds (sunflower seeds, safflower seeds, castor seeds, groundnuts and sesame seeds), pulses (chana, toor dal, lobia, urad dal and gram), spices (bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cumin and pepper) and cereals (buckwheat and oats).

### Do you supply quinoa and chia seeds in bulk?
Yes. Quinoa in regular, bold, red, black and tricolor, chia seeds in black and white, and pumpkin, flax, basil (sabja) and hulled sunflower seeds.

### What is the price of millets per kg?
Prices move with the crop and the market, so we quote the day's rate for your product, quantity and delivery town. WhatsApp 92455 55556 for a quote.

### Which certifications does Rithwik Industries hold?
Spices Board India, HACCP, FSSAI, APEDA, Halal, ISO, BRCGS and US FDA. Our GSTIN is 37ABKFR7391G1ZM.

### Are Rithwik Industries and Rithwik Bird Feeds the same family?
Yes. They are two businesses of one Kurnool family, in a grain trade that began in 1925: Rithwik Industries supplies food grains, Rithwik Bird Feeds supplies bird feed. Both are on this website.

### How do I contact Rithwik Industries?
Call or WhatsApp 92455 55556, or email rithwikindustries@gmail.com. Our office is at 87/1404, Dhanalakshmi Nagar, near Nandyal Checkpost, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh 518002, and our main warehouse at Duvvur. rithwikbirdfeeds.com is our official website.

## History

- 1925: Bysani Govindappa, Sathyanarayana & Co
- 1945: Bysani Satyanarayana, Sathyanarayana & Co
- 1976: Bysani SubbaRaju, Krishna Sai Traders
- 2011: Bysani Sudheer, Viraanch Exports and Imports
- 2022: Bysani Vasavi, Rithwik Bird Feeds and Rithwik Industries
